description.value: China Bowl Restaurant is a family-owned Chinese restaurant in Langley specializing in Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine, including classics like beef and broccoli, hot bean sauce prawns, and wonton soup. Touring cyclists can order dine-in or takeout, and the restaurant also offers catering for large events. It operates out of a strip-mall unit on 200 Street in south Langley.
